name: Free Movement of Goods
description: Aligning Ukrainian product standards, technical regulations, and conformity assessment with EU norms to enable barrier-free trade of goods.

name: Freedom of Movement for Workers
description: Establishing rights for Ukrainian workers in the EU and vice versa, including mutual recognition of professional qualifications.

name: Right of Establishment and Freedom to Provide Services
description: Opening markets for businesses and service providers, including financial, postal, and professional services.

name: Free Movement of Capital
description: Liberalising capital flows, harmonising rules on foreign investment, and aligning anti-money-laundering frameworks.

name: Public Procurement
description: Reforming Ukrainian procurement rules to ensure open, transparent, and competitive tendering aligned with EU directives.

name: Company Law
description: Harmonising corporate legislation, accounting standards, and corporate governance requirements with EU company law.

name: Intellectual Property Law
description: Strengthening IP protection including patents, trademarks, copyright, and enforcement mechanisms.

name: Competition Policy
description: Bringing state aid rules and antitrust enforcement in line with EU competition law.

name: Financial Services
description: Aligning banking, insurance, and investment regulations with EU financial services directives.

name: Information Society and Media
description: Updating rules on electronic communications, audiovisual media services, and digital single market alignment.

name: Agriculture and Rural Development
description: Reforming agricultural policy, food safety standards, and rural development programs to meet Common Agricultural Policy standards.

name: Food Safety, Veterinary and Phytosanitary Policy
description: Implementing EU food safety standards, sanitary controls, and phytosanitary measures across the food chain.

name: Fisheries
description: Aligning fisheries management, conservation, and control measures with the EU's Common Fisheries Policy.

name: Transport Policy
description: Harmonising road, rail, air, and inland waterway transport rules, including safety standards and market access.

name: Energy
description: Integrating Ukraine's energy market with the EU, including electricity, gas, renewables, and nuclear safety alignment.

name: Taxation
description: Harmonising VAT, excise duties, and direct taxation with EU tax acquis and OECD standards.

name: Economic and Monetary Policy
description: Aligning macroeconomic frameworks, central bank independence, and preparing for eventual eurozone integration.

name: Statistics
description: Ukraine has aligned statistical methodology with Eurostat standards, enabling comparable data on economy, society, and environment.

name: Social Policy and Employment
description: Updating labour law, health and safety at work, and social dialogue mechanisms to meet EU standards.

name: Enterprise and Industrial Policy
description: Improving the business environment, supporting SMEs, and aligning industrial policy with EU competitiveness goals.

name: Trans-European Networks
description: Integrating Ukrainian transport and energy infrastructure into Trans-European Networks (TEN-T and TEN-E).

name: Regional Policy and Coordination of Structural Instruments
description: Building capacity to implement cohesion policy, manage structural funds, and reduce regional disparities.

name: Judiciary and Fundamental Rights
description: Reforming the justice system, strengthening anti-corruption institutions, and protecting fundamental rights.

name: Justice, Freedom and Security
description: Aligning asylum policy, border management, migration rules, and police cooperation with EU frameworks.

name: Science and Research
description: Ukraine is fully integrated into Horizon Europe and has strong institutional links with EU research networks.

name: Education and Culture
description: Expanding participation in Erasmus+, aligning higher education with Bologna Process, and cultural cooperation.

name: Environment and Climate Change
description: Implementing EU environmental directives on water, air, waste, and aligning with the European Green Deal.

name: Consumer and Health Protection
description: Strengthening consumer rights enforcement and aligning public health and pharmaceutical regulations.

name: Customs Union
description: Modernising Ukrainian customs procedures, IT systems, and aligning with the EU Customs Code.

name: External Relations
description: Aligning foreign policy instruments and trade agreements with Common Commercial Policy.

name: Foreign, Security and Defence Policy
description: Deepening participation in Common Foreign and Security Policy (CFSP) and Crisis Management.

name: Financial Control
description: Establishing public internal financial control systems and aligning with EU audit and accountability standards.

name: Finance and Budgetary Provisions
description: Preparing administrative capacity to manage EU budget contributions and structural fund financing.

name: Institutions
description: Reviewing institutional arrangements, translation capacity, and preparedness for EU institutional participation.

name: Other Matters
description: Covering transitional arrangements, derogations, and remaining technical issues not addressed in other chapters.
